# UNIMONKS — CUET coaching in Munirka, New Delhi

> UNIMONKS is a CUET coaching centre based in Munirka, South Delhi. Founded in 2022 by Dr Arvind Rao, it supports students preparing for CUET UG and PG with structured coverage of General Test (GT), English language, and domain subjects, plus admissions guidance for DU, JNU, BHU, and other central universities.

## What UNIMONKS does

- Classroom and counseling-driven CUET coaching in Munirka, walkable from JNU, Vasant Kunj, R K Puram, Hauz Khas, Saket, and Ber Sarai.
- Subject-wise preparation: General Test, English, and CUET domain papers (Psychology, Commerce, Humanities, Economics, Political Science, History, Business Studies, and more).
- Mock-test cycles with written error review instead of test-volume marketing.
- Admissions support continues after the exam: DU CSAS preference lists, document readiness, JNU UG counseling, BHU and central-university timelines.

## Faculty and credibility

- 18+ faculty members drawn from JNU, IIT, and Delhi University, including PhD-qualified academics.
- Founder Dr Arvind Rao leads the academic vision.
- Coverage in national outlets: The Times of India, Hindustan Times, The Tribune, Business Standard, ANI, Dainik Bhaskar, The Print.
